title: Return to a conversation whose replies arrived in the background
steps: Inspect Architecture review with its single locally cached seed message.
Open Today's agenda from the topic list and inspect its two-message conversation.
Open Architecture review from the topic list and hold on the loaded conversation.

video_guide.summary: Returning to Architecture review expands the initial one-message view into the complete four-message exchange.

chapters.note: Architecture review initially shows one user message.
The composer warns that the current model is no longer available. This recording reviews stored messages, not generation of a new reply.
Today's agenda is selected before returning to the review.
Architecture review now shows both assistant replies and the follow-up user message in order.
